audit_scope: APD6 linked experiment and literature rows were reconciled against primary Table 1, Table 2, toxicity text/Figure 3, supplement tables, and merged APD6 sequence/activity rows; conflicts are preserved rather than normalized.

record_audits.database_subject: TC-33 (natural AMPs; cathelicidin, mammals, animals; XXA, UCLL1c)
record_audits.database_measure: APD6 entry-text MIC claims for E. coli ATCC8739, A. baumannii ATCC19606, P. aeruginosa ATCC27853, and S. aureus ATCC6538 match primary Table 2 values for TC-33.

sequence_check.agreement: core amino-acid sequence matches primary Table 1; primary source explicitly includes C-terminal amidation (-NH2), so the modified sequence is not normalized to an unmodified sequence.

name_check.agreement: TC-33 name and mature peptide identity are primary-source located in Results/Table 1.

activity_check.agreement: Table 2 supports TC-33 MIC values of 150, 75, 37.5, and 75 μg/mL for the four standard strains.

toxicity_check.agreement: Primary text/Figure 3 supports no detected cytotoxicity or hemolysis up to 100 μg/mL.

modification_check.database_annotation: APD6 merged sequence omits explicit -NH2 terminal marker while primary Table 1 reports -NH2.
modification_check.source_status: primary-supported C-terminal amidation preserved as modification, not normalized

record_audits.conflict_context: No activity-value conflict was found for Table 2 TC-33 MIC rows, but the database/core sequence is not a complete modified sequence because the primary paper reports C-terminal amidation (-NH2).
record_audits.review_notes: Do not treat the unmodified core sequence as a fully normalized primary sequence; keep C-terminal amidation explicit.

record_audits.database_subject: TC-14 (TC-33 analog, synthetic AMPs, Lys-rich, XXA, UCLL1c; BBMm)
record_audits.database_measure: APD6 entry-text MIC claims mostly match primary Table 2, but S. aureus ATCC6538 is listed as 4.68 μg/mL in APD6 versus 4.69 μg/mL in primary Table 2, and APD6 resistance wording overstates the S. aureus serial-passage result.

sequence_check.agreement: core amino-acid sequence matches primary Table 1; C-terminal amidation is primary-supported and not normalized away.

name_check.agreement: TC-14 name and derivation from TC-33 active region are primary-source located in Results/Table 1.

activity_check.agreement: Primary Table 2 supports TC-14 MIC values of 9.38, 2.34, 9.38, and 4.69 μg/mL for the four standard strains; Table S1/S2 add source-supported clinical-isolate and plasma MIC rows.

toxicity_check.agreement: Primary text/Figure 3 and Figure S1 support no detected in vitro cytotoxicity/hemolysis up to 100 μg/mL and no observable acute mouse toxicity at 10 mg/kg over 48 h.

mechanism_check.agreement: Primary Figures 4-5 support membrane permeabilization/rupture mechanism evidence; PI binding to nucleic acids is assay readout context, not a nucleic-acid-target claim.

record_audits.conflict_context: APD6 TC-14 row is source-linked and mostly source-supported, but it rounds/transcribes the S. aureus Table 2 MIC as 4.68 rather than 4.69 μg/mL and says S. aureus did not become resistant after 60 generations despite primary text reporting a 2-fold MIC increase after five passages; these conflicts are preserved rather than smoothed.
record_audits.review_notes: Keep APD6 as source_conflict for the discrepant S. aureus MIC/resistance wording while preserving source-supported TC-14 Table 2, Table S1, Table S2, toxicity, mechanism, and in-vivo activity evidence.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary Table 1 includes -NH2 on TC-33 and TC-14; merged APD6 core sequences omit the explicit terminal amide marker.
APD6 lists S. aureus ATCC6538 MIC 4.68 μg/mL, while primary Table 2 lists 4.69 μg/mL.
Primary serial-passage text reports a 2-fold S. aureus MIC increase after five passages for TC-14; APD6 says no resistance development for S. aureus.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The method mentions evaluating P. aeruginosa during the plasma assay, but local Table S2/text only tabulates A. baumannii and S. aureus time-course MIC values.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: No P. aeruginosa plasma time-course rows were fabricated; Table S2-supported rows remain recorded.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Figure 3, Figure 4, Figure 5, Figure 6, Figure 7, Figure S1, and Figure S2 provide plotted/image evidence; exact graph point values beyond prose/table values are not present in local text tables.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Only text/table-supported values are curated; mechanism/toxicity/effect claims are bounded to qualitative or prose-reported values.
